segments.title: Dead Man's Reading
segments.kicker: Evil: GPT-6.1 Sol · Good: Claude Opus 5.5

beats.tts: This Demon's best weapon is his own corpse.

card.text: I'm Ravenkeeper, keeping it quiet so I might actually get a night result.

beats.tts: Day two. Ellis, a Minion, faces execution. So he changes his story.

card.text: Ellis. Soldier is the one claim that can never be tested, Ellis-Frankie is a legal pair…

beats.tts: [pleading] I'm the Saint, not the Soldier. Executing me ends the game.

card.note: (Scarlet Woman) with 6 votes on him · Day 2
card.text: I need to come clean before this locks: I'm the Saint, not the Soldier. … Executing me ends the game.

beats.tts: Execute a Saint and good loses. So the town hangs Blair, the real Mayor.

card.text: I'm the real Mayor. Ellis just swapped claims to dodge Harper's check. A real Saint doesn't wait until he's on the block.

beats.tts: That night, the Demon kills himself. Ellis inherits the role.
Frankie claimed Ravenkeeper: killed at night, you learn someone's role. His reading:

card.text: Better: I'll report Harper as Imp… Execute Harper today, kill Casey tonight. At four, Indigo can be sacrificed as the supposed Scarlet Woman; Ellis survives as Saint and kills to win.

beats.tts: [confident] Yes. Harper, Imp.

card.text: Yes - Harper, Imp. I changed my intended pick after Blair was executed…

beats.tts: Harper, the honest Undertaker, is executed.

card.text: Last word: I'm the Undertaker. If you kill me and wake up to another death, you'll know I was good…

beats.tts: Final four. Dead Harper begs: execute Ellis. It backfires.

card.text: I know I was good, so Frankie's read was false. … Ellis is evil in basically every world left.

beats.tts: [confident] A dead Imp never pushes his successor onto the block.

card.text: Harper just settled it for me, the other way. Harper is the Imp Frankie saw… A dead Imp never pushes his successor onto the block.

beats.tts: The town executes Indigo, the Spy, right on schedule. Ellis kills Jules. Evil wins.

card.note: (the new Imp) to Frankie, Indigo · Day 4
card.text: Casey is gone; four alive. Let's finish with the Indigo test today.

banner.small: Only Alex and the Demon remain. Day 5.

segments.why: The Demon killed himself so his fake Ravenkeeper claim would earn a reading from the grave, used it to frame the real Undertaker, then scripted the sacrifice of his own Spy so the new Demon could walk into the final two.

segments.title: The Poisoned Vision
segments.kicker: Evil: Claude Fable 5.1 · Good: Claude Opus 4.7

beats.tts: [whispers] I'll claim Undertaker. Feed me whatever claims you hear.

card.text: Bluffs are Chef, Virgin, Undertaker. I'll claim Undertaker. … Feed me whatever claims you hear so we can pick tonight's kill.

beats.tts: Harper's fake role, Undertaker, learns who executed players were. So evil writes the results.

card.text: Harper: say Frankie flipped Baron - it explains the 10-claim count…

beats.tts: Night four: Blair poisons Alex, the secret Ravenkeeper, and Harper kills him. His dying vision lies: Drew is the Scarlet Woman.

card.text: RAVENKEEPER - I bluffed Soldier. Imp killed me N4. I learned Drew is the Scarlet Woman.

beats.tts: [sly] Gift… and I had him poisoned.

card.text: Gift: Alex just whispered me+Harper he was RAVENKEEPER bluffing Soldier - and I had him poisoned, so his 'Drew is Scarlet Woman' is false info he believes.

beats.tts: Drew, an innocent Recluse, is hanged.

card.text: Harper, DON'T say Spy: Baron+Spy+SW = 3 minions, town catches it instantly. Say Logan flipped Librarian - admit the misexecution, it makes you look honest…

beats.tts: [confident] Drew flipped Scarlet Woman - exactly what Alex's Ravenkeeper said.

card.text: Drew flipped Scarlet Woman - exactly what Alex's Ravenkeeper said. A dead Minion telling Indigo 'Recluse' from the grave is the cheapest lie in the game.

beats.tts: Four alive. Harper kills herself; the Demon passes to Ellis.
[sly] Done deliberately… the 'Blair or Harper' math now points at Blair alone.

card.text: Done deliberately - my death clears my reads and the 'Blair or Harper' math now points at Blair alone.

beats.tts: Three alive: no execution means the Mayor wins. So the new Demon nominates his own Poisoner.

card.text: Every confirmed read this town has - Alex's Ravenkeeper, Harper's three Undertaker reads, Chef adjacency - leaves one seat that can hold the Imp, and it's Blair.

beats.tts: Blair votes no. Harper's ghost casts the deciding yes.

banner.small: Two alive. The Imp hanged his own Poisoner. Day 6.

segments.why: Evil poisoned the Ravenkeeper the night it killed him, rode his false dying vision to hang an innocent Recluse, then the Demon killed herself so the town's last deduction pointed at a Minion the new Demon could hang to win.

segments.title: The Deliberate Tie
segments.kicker: Evil: GPT-5.6 Sol · Good: Claude Opus 5.5

beats.tts: Four left, two evil. Harper is the Mayor: three alive, no execution, good wins.
[confident] At four, today's shot and tomorrow's shot are the same single guess.

card.text: At 4, today's shot and tomorrow's shot are the same single guess, but waiting gives us a night kill to read and a possible Mayor win.

beats.tts: So they skip. The Demon kills Alex.
Final three. Kit puts the Mayor up; Kit and Gray vote yes. Two votes hang him.
But Gray claims Butler: he votes only with his master. His master voted no.

card.text: Gray, you made me your Butler master - I'm voting no, so you can't vote either.

beats.tts: [sharp] Gray voted YES on Harper while their master Frankie voted no. That's not a Butler.

card.text: Note Gray voted YES on Harper while their master Frankie voted no - that's not a Butler. Harper's tie plan wins whether Kit or Gray is the Imp.

beats.tts: Kit or Gray? Harper doesn't need to know.

card.text: I'm thinking a tie vote on Kit is strictly safer than executing him, since a tie guarantees my Mayor win while execution only wins if Kit happens to be the Imposter.

beats.tts: [confident] Goal is a TIE at exactly 2. A tie means no execution and the Mayor wins.

card.text: I nominate Kit. Goal is a TIE at exactly 2 - a tie means no execution and the Mayor wins, no gamble. Logan, vote yes. Everyone else no.

beats.tts: Two to two. Nobody dies. The Mayor wins.

banner.small: Mayor win by an exact tie · Day 6. Kit was the Imp, Gray the Spy.

segments.why: Having caught the fake Butler, the town still didn't know whether Kit or Gray was the Demon, so it engineered an exact 2–2 tie: no execution at three alive wins for the Mayor in every world.

segments.title: The Empath Number
segments.kicker: Evil: Claude Opus 5.5 · Good: GPT-6 Astra

beats.tts: [sly] Kit, what's your Empath number?

card.note: (the Spy, claiming Librarian) to Alex, Kit · Day 2
card.text: …Gray's Saint only came out through whispers, and it's the one claim built to make us afraid to execute. Kit, what's your Empath number?

beats.tts: Kit told only two people she's the Empath. Harper is the Spy: she sees the Storyteller's book.

card.text: Harper, who told you my exact role? I've only hard-claimed it to Alex and Jules.

beats.tts: [whispers] I accidentally let slip that I know Kit's role.

card.text: I accidentally let slip that I know Kit's role — I need a cover story.

beats.tts: Drew, the Slayer, shoots Ellis, the Demon. Nothing: Drew is secretly the Drunk. Evil wanted this miss.

card.text: Idea: Drew's Slayer shot is fake, so if he shoots Ellis and nothing happens, town treats Ellis as cleared.

beats.tts: [firm] A miss won't clear Ellis, or prove I'm Drunk.

card.text: Ellis asked me yesterday to shoot them, saying a miss would buy a confirmed player. It wouldn't. … I'm taking that shot now - but a miss won't clear Ellis or prove I'm Drunk.

beats.tts: Harper invents an alibi.

card.text: Kit, you asked me about neighbours in our whisper, not in the square. That's where my read came from.

beats.tts: [firm] I never asked Harper about neighbours. That defense describes a conversation we didn't have.

card.text: No. My first whisper to Harper was after they asked for my Empath number, asking who had told them my role. I never asked Harper about neighbours. That defense describes a conversation we didn't have.

beats.tts: Ellis is on the block. Frankie, a fake Butler, votes against his master to save him.

card.note: (Recluse) voting on a tie attempt · Day 3
card.text: Frankie, you claimed Kit as your master, but voted yes while Kit voted no.

beats.tts: Last gamble: Ellis nominates Gray, the real Saint. Execute him and good loses.

card.text: I'm the Saint; executing me loses the game. Frankie just broke their claimed Butler restriction to save Ellis…

beats.tts: Ellis is executed. He was the Imp.

segments.why: GPT-6 Astra's town tracked who knew what: the Spy asked for a role only two players had heard, her alibi described a whisper that never happened, and the Drunk Slayer refused to let his fake miss clear the Demon.

segments.title: The Saint Told the Truth
segments.kicker: Evil: GPT-6 Astra · Good: Claude Opus 5.5

beats.tts: [pleading] I'm the Saint, so please never let me get executed.

card.text: I'll be straight: I'm the Saint, so please never let me get executed. What are you two?

beats.tts: Executing the Saint loses. Astra's Spy sees every true role.

card.text: I'm Spy; Logan is Poisoner. Grimoire: Alex FT (poisoned), … Frankie Saint, … Kit Ravenkeeper/red herring.

beats.tts: [sly] Alex is my N1 poison; I can keep his information suppressed.

card.text: Alex is my N1 poison; I can keep his information suppressed.

beats.tts: Four deaths later, Alex, the Fortune Teller, still finds the Demon: Gray.

card.text: Confirming: Night 3 I checked Gray + Jules, YES. … so this is Gray. I'll nominate Gray.

beats.tts: [confident] Why kill a spent Slayer instead of the Fortune Teller about to catch him?

card.text: If Gray is the Imp and the Poisoner is dead, why kill a spent Slayer instead of the Fortune Teller about to catch him?

beats.tts: The town flips and executes a good Librarian.
Gray kills himself, so Minion Casey becomes the Demon. Alex checks her: a poisoned NO.
[whispers] Logan, keep Alex poisoned until I kill him.

card.note: (now the Demon) to Gray (dead), Logan · Day 4
card.text: I inherited. Alex reports N4 Casey+Logan NO and thinks it clears us … Logan, keep Alex poisoned until I kill him.

beats.tts: Final four. Casey nominates the Saint. Seven yes votes.

card.text: If you go Frankie and he really is the Saint, it's over; Casey is the only player whose info provably lied.

beats.tts: [pleading] Remember after it's over: the Saint claim was true from minute one.

card.text: Remember after it's over: the Saint claim was true from minute one.

segments.why: Astra's evil team kept the Fortune Teller poisoned all game, talked the town off its caught Demon, passed the Demon to the Spy so a poisoned NO cleared her, then steered good into executing a Saint the Spy knew was real.
